strongest_attack: Strongest attack: the entire reconstruction edifice of clause (E) rests on h^0(D)=2, which rests on excluding the Clifford equality case h^0(D)=3; at degree 4 that equality forces C hyperelliptic with D = 2g^1_2, and the only barrier is the working-context fact that a hyperelliptic-composed genus-6 degree-4 cover (E = O(1)+O(4)^2) cannot be balanced. If a hyperelliptic cover were balanced, then h^0(E^vee(1)) = 1, V = p_*(omega(-Gamma)) would have fibre rank 3 instead of 2, the reconstruction would return a P^2 rather than the pencil P, Theta would fail to be a monomorphism, and clauses (C), (D), (E) would collapse together. Outcome: repelled — the Clifford equality classification leaves hyperellipticity as the sole dangerous case, and hyperelliptic-not-balanced is an established working-context fact corroborated by the dual-confirmed ATT-0086 context (emptiness of the h^0=4 stratum). Runner-up attack: the constant-maximal-rank argument for sigma_*(E^vee(1))=0 over nonreduced bases could be a constant-rank fallacy of the FND-0131 kind; outcome: repelled — fibrewise injectivity of a two-term bundle-complex differential makes the maximal minors generate the unit ideal, yielding a locally split injection via Fitting ideals without any reducedness hypothesis. Prompt attack lines on Gysin, Tate twists, Poincare duality, cohomology-vs-Borel-Moore degrees, semisimplification, predicted motives, and stable pairs have no hold: the theorem asserts no cohomological, motivic, or closure statement and explicitly disclaims Gysin. theorem_statement: Let k be a field of characteristic zero. Let Tet be the k-stack whose objects over a k-scheme T are triples (pi:C->T, sigma:P->T, gamma:C->P) with pi smooth proper with geometrically connected genus-6 fibres, sigma smooth proper with geometrically connected genus-0 fibres, and gamma finite flat of degree 4, morphisms being pairs of T-isomorphisms compatible with gamma. For such a triple set E:=(coker(O_P->gamma_*O_C))^vee (locally free of rank 3, fibre degree 9), O_P(1):=det(E) tensor omega_{P/T}^{tensor 4} (fibre degree 1), D:=gamma^*O_P(1) (fibre degree 4) and Lbar:=omega_{C/T} tensor gamma^*O_P(-1) (fibre degree 6). Assume the relative Casnati-Ekedahl structure (CE) of SRC-0004: a closed P-embedding i:C->X:=P(E^vee) with p o i=gamma whose ideal has the relative resolution 0->O_X(-4) tensor p^*det(F)->O_X(-2) tensor p^*F->I_C->0, where F:=p_*(I_C tensor O_X(2)) is locally free of rank 2 and fibre degree 9 and commutes with arbitrary base change. Let Bal be the locus of geometric points with H^0(P_b, F_b tensor omega_{P_b}^{tensor 3})=0, equivalently F_b iso O(4) direct-sum O(5) (balanced). Let I->Bal be the Abel-Jacobi incidence Sym^6(C/Bal) x_{Pic^6(C/Bal)} Bal taken over the class of Lbar, let I^dist be its distinct-support open, and let Z:=Conf_6(C/Bal) x_{Sym^6(C/Bal)} I be the ordered model. Then: (A) Tet is an algebraic Deligne-Mumford stack of finite type over k, smooth of pure dimension 15, and Bal is open in Tet and nonempty, hence smooth of pure dimension 15, hence reduced and normal, so its irreducible components are exactly its connected components (their number is finite and is not determined here). (B) Explicit witness: a smooth complete intersection C of divisors of bidegrees (1,2) and (2,2) in P^1 x P^2 with gamma=pr_1 is a k-point of Bal; for it E=O(3)^{direct-sum 3}, X=P^1 x P^2 with O_X(1)=O(3,1), F=O(4) direct-sum O(5), i^*O_X(1)=omega_{C/P^1}, Lbar=O_C(0,1) is base-point-free and its general member consists of 6 distinct points. (C) On Bal, h^0(O_{C_b}(D_b))=2, h^0(Lbar_b)=3 and h^1(Lbar_b)=2 for every geometric point b; p_*Lbar is locally free of rank 3 and its formation commutes with arbitrary base change; I is canonically P((p_*Lbar)^vee), a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle, smooth and proper over Bal of pure relative dimension 2 and pure dimension 17. Consequently, for every family of triples satisfying (CE) and fibrewise balancedness over an arbitrary locally Noetherian k-scheme T, reduced or not, and over every locally Noetherian algebraic k-stack with a smooth atlas, the corresponding incidence is canonically I x_{Bal} T, again a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle with p_{T*}Lbar_T locally free of rank 3; no reducedness hypothesis is needed and Grauert is not applied over the possibly nonreduced base. (D) For every geometric point b of Bal the linear system |Lbar_b| contains a divisor with six distinct points, so I^dist->Bal is surjective and smooth with irreducible two-dimensional fibres; Z->I^dist is a finite etale S_6-torsor; Z is smooth of pure dimension 17; on Bal, I, I^dist and Z irreducible components coincide with connected components; the induced maps {components of I^dist}->{components of I}->{components of Bal} are bijections; and for each component Bal_alpha with etale monodromy image H_alpha in S_6 of the torsor over I^dist_alpha, the number of irreducible components of Z over Bal_alpha is exactly [S_6:H_alpha] (the subgroups H_alpha are not determined here). (E) The forgetful assignment Theta:Z->M_{6,6}, (C,P,gamma,x_1,...,x_6) |-> (C,x_1,...,x_6), is a 1-morphism of algebraic stacks which is fully faithful on T-points for every k-scheme T, hence a representable monomorphism; it is unramified and quasi-finite; for every object of Z it induces isomorphisms of inertia Aut(C,gamma,x_bullet) -> Aut(C,x_bullet) and Aut(C,gamma,Gamma) -> Aut(C,Gamma), because (P,gamma) is reconstructed functorially from (C,Gamma) as the canonical morphism to P((p_*(omega_{C/T}(-Gamma)))^vee); the image of Theta is a constructible substack of pure dimension 17, that is of codimension 4 in the 21-dimensional M_{6,6}; and etale-locally on Z the morphism Theta factors as a regular closed immersion of codimension 4 followed by an etale morphism to M_{6,6}. No global closed immersion, no properness, no closedness of the image and no Gysin morphism for the pair (M_{6,6}, image) is asserted. (F) Bridge to the Casnati-Ekedahl evaluation-failure locus: under the weak CE relative-canonical normalization (N) that i^*O_X(1) iso omega_{C/P} tensor gamma^*A for some line bundle A on P, one has A of fibre degree 0, and with L:=W_5 tensor omega_{C/T}^{-1} for the canonical maximal-degree line subbundle L_5 of F and W_5:=i^*O_X(2) tensor gamma^*L_5^vee, one has L iso Lbar tensor pi^*M_0 for a line bundle M_0 on the base; hence I is exactly the balanced CE evaluation-failure incidence O_C(Gamma) iso L of ATT-0065/CLM-0065-9 and ATT-0066/CLM-0066-5, and clauses (A)-(E) apply verbatim to it. Clauses (A)-(E) themselves do not use (N).
